about.description: CASH is a Solana-native fiat-backed stablecoin issued by Bridge Building Inc. (BBI). It is designed to maintain a $1 peg and is backed by a segregated reserve portfolio that may include cash, U. S. Treasuries, and money market funds (or tokenized equivalents). It is positioned for onchain payments and settlement with an issuer-managed redemption process. key risks are issuer/custodian risk, reserve management and disclosure quality, and redemption access/timing.
